title: Design: Edit Line shows a former technician as an ordinary chip with its X
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member C, at the test location, with Time Clock on and Technician on.
  • Have a new open service work order for this test, at the test location with an approved labor line, with staff member C added to it with Add Technician and no time logged on it.
  • Then switch Technician off for staff member C in Edit Staff Member, click Save & Close and click Save in the Turn Off Technician warning.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Open the labor line in the Edit Line window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Staff member C shows in Add Technician as an ordinary chip, not grayed out, with its X to remove it, the same as the other technicians' chips.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R8: “In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip that can be removed with its X, unless they have logged time on the line, in which case the chip shows the existing lock and "This technician has logged time on the line and cannot be removed.", as today.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, Google Sheet "Technician Toggle – questions for Chris Ward (2 Nov 2026)", https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nLKkgSgmtqCYu4eu15_9xN38ml32tDnJls42PPq_A4M, column E, answered 2 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-02/ANSWERS-Chris-Ward-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Answer 6 (question 6): “6. (a) As the PRD says: an ordinary chip, not grayed out, removable with its X, with the lock if they have logged time on the line. Grayed out means deactivated, and this person isn't deactivated. I'll fix the page 6 note in the design.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Add Technician on a line" (This build); the chip is not drawn (register TT-N10).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p6-04-after-add-technician-on-a-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip, not grayed out, removable with its X; the lock shows instead if they logged time on the line. Grayed out still means a deactivated technician, as today.”

Ruled: Chris answered question 6 (a), as the PRD; the design's page 6 note now matches it (register TT-D02, PO-RULED). The design-version case D-34 is deleted.
